_comment: Pin for the Microsoft VC++ 2015-2022 x64 Redistributable bundled into the Windows installer. Recorded 2026-10-10 by the 'Pin VC++ redistributable' workflow (run 38065191484): the download was validly Authenticode-signed by Microsoft Corporation. Caveat: the aka.ms URL always serves Microsoft's NEWEST build, so release builds fail (safely) whenever Microsoft ships a newer one; re-run that workflow, review, and commit. For a stable pin, host the reviewed file in a location we control and set url to it.
